title: Structure Aware Neural Architecture Search for Mixture of Experts
abstract: arXiv:2608.29817v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has so far rarely been applied to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, and existing MoE designs leave the alignment between experts and the structure of the data to emerge on its own. We propose an architecture search framework that makes this alignment an explicit search variable: the assignment of data clusters to experts is optimised jointly with the per-expert architectures. We cast the joint problem as a cluster-aware likelihood maximisation, show that it coincides with the incomplete-data maximum likelihood of a latent-variable mixture, and solve it by a generalised Expectation-Maximisation procedure whose otherwise intractable expert-quality term is supplied by an adaptively refined surrogate. We prove that the iterates converge whenever the surrogate errors are summable, and that at every limit point no candidate the search produces improves the true objective. On a heterogeneous image-classification

translated_title: 面向混合专家模型的结构感知神经架构搜索
translated_abstract: 神经架构搜索（NAS）迄今为止很少被应用于混合专家模型，而现有的MoE设计将专家与数据结构之间的对齐问题留待其自发形成。我们提出了一种架构搜索框架，将这种对齐作为显式的搜索变量：数据簇到专家的分配与每个专家的架构被联合优化。我们将该联合问题表述为簇感知的似然最大化问题，证明其与隐变量混合模型的不完全数据最大似然相吻合，并通过一种广义期望最大化（EM）程序进行求解，其中原本难以处理的专家质量项由一个自适应精化的代理函数提供。我们证明，只要代理误差是可求和的，迭代过程就会收敛，并且在每个极限点处，搜索产生的任何候选解都无法进一步改进真实目标函数。在异构图像分类……（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种结构感知的神经架构搜索框架，将数据簇与专家的对齐作为显式搜索变量，通过广义EM算法联合优化专家分配与各专家架构，并从理论上证明了算法的收敛性与极限点的最优性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a structure-aware neural architecture search framework for Mixture-of-Experts that makes expert-data alignment an explicit search variable, jointly optimizing data cluster-to-expert assignments and per-expert architectures via a generalized Expectation-Maximization procedure with proven convergence guarantees.
